newsitem.title: UK: UK poll shows Labour lead over Conservatives steady.
newsitem.headline: UK poll shows Labour lead over Conservatives steady.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party maintained a 16-point lead over the ruling Conservatives ahead of next week's general election, according to a Gallup poll in Saturday's Daily Telegraph newspaper.
The daily survey put Labour support at 48 percent of voters and the Conservatives at 32 percent, unchanged from the previous day's poll. The Liberal Democrats gained two points to 14 percent.
Most opinion polls have continued to show Labour comfortably ahead of the Conservatives as the May 1 election approaches.
Apart from an ICM poll in Wednesday's Guardian newspaper which put Labour's lead at five points, polls have consistently given Labour a double-figure lead.
